title: A grow batch, as its holder counted it: how many plants are in the batch, how many of them are in flower, and the area they grow on. Counts are whole numbers. The area is in square metres times 100 (12.50 m² is 1250). The numbers are the holder's own statement on the date the record was sealed; nobody measured them for the holder. Which batch, where and of what is in the record the numbers are sealed with, not here. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
